office: the Immigration and Civil Status Department (Passport Section)

routes.label: in Seychelles, collected 72 hours (3 working days) after enrolment
enrolled at an embassy, posted from Seychelles

note: The biometric passport's fee is SCR 750; enrolled at an embassy it's SCR 750 and SCR 1,000 postage from Seychelles. A lost passport's penalty (SCR 1,500) isn't modelled. Validity isn't stated on the Department's pages, a lead.

sources.title: Immigration and Civil Status Department, Seychelles, Applying for a Seychelles Passport
sources.said: Collection may be done 72 hours (3 working days) after enrollment. ... FEES APPLICABLE FOR THE BIOMETRIC PASSPORT ENROLLMENT AT THE EMBASSY Renewal or New Passport Passport Fee SR 750.00 Postage fee from Seychelles SR1,000.00 SR1,750.00

sources.title: Immigration and Civil Status Department, Seychelles, FAQ: Seychelles Bio-Metric Passport
sources.said: The fee of the Bio-Metric passport remains the same at SCR750 per applicant. The payment is made after the application has been submitted and can be paid by card or cash. You may receive your new passport in 72hours after application.
